title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode3 White Miku

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I've got school tomorrow, so I should log off.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yawn... I stayed up all night yesterday, so I should probably get some sleep too.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Alright. I think I'm going to work on it a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Good work today, Enanan! Yuki! Talk to you tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks for breakfast.
See you later, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Will you be home at the regular time today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah. I should be back by five.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Make sure to let me know if you're going to be late.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry, Mom. I will.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just can't get this part to look right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The shadow coloring looks all wrong. Maybe if I give it a little more blue... No, that just makes it worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh... It's no good.
I just can't seem to draw today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How would I look from this angle?
Yeah, I like that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. So many likes already♪ I'm getting more followers, too. I'll hit 7,000 soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wish my illustration account would get some more followers, though...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm...
This doesn't really suit this video.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Too bad. The design is so cute, too...
Oh well, maybe I'll make something myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hello? Oh, hi Teach! Long time no see♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, I see. My attendance numbers? Yeah yeah, I understand. I'll make sure I go to supplementary classes next week. See you then!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sigh... I guess I have to go to school again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I really like this one! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you. I'll be sure to bring one the next time I visit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, how is my father doing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
No, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's a comment on the last song we posted.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <It's scary how much this sucks you in.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Kinda dark, but it's also somehow reassuring. I feel like I can finally get some sleep tonight thanks to this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(As long as my songs can help someone...
As long as people can relate to them...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to keep making songs that can save people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? What was... My screen, it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What is this? Some kind of video?
But I didn't click on anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It sounds like it's trying to say something...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come quickly? What's that supposed to mean?
